## Secrets: load the service configuration (one call)

```rust
use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::secrets::{load_config, LoadOptions};
let values = load_config(LoadOptions { required: vec!["DATABASE_URL".into()], ..Default::default() }).await?;
```

- `load_config(LoadOptions) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>>`; `LoadOptions { required, into_env (default
  true → std::env::set_var), keep_existing, path, env, connector }`.
- Bootstrap `GROW_SECRETS_PROVIDER` (must be `__KEY__`), `GROW_SECRETS_ADDR`, `GROW_SECRETS_KV_MOUNT`,
  `GROW_SECRETS_PATH`, `GROW_SECRETS_AUTH=approle` + `GROW_SECRETS_ROLE_ID`/`_SECRET_ID`. Missing required keys →
  `NOT_FOUND`. No bootstrap or `GROW_SECRETS_LOADED=1` → only the required check.
- Also: `load_config_from`, `read_secrets_bootstrap`, `secrets_preloaded`.
<!-- @sdk-kit:endif -->

## Logging: one call

```rust
use grow___KEY_SNAKE__::logging::{init_logging, InitOptions};
let log = init_logging(InitOptions { service: Some("orders".into()), ..Default::default() });
log.logger().log(grow___KEY_SNAKE__::logging::Severity::Info, "started", Default::default());
// tracing: tracing_subscriber::registry().with(LogLayer::new(log.client())).init();
log.close().await?;
```

- JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`, `trace_id`, attributes,
  redacted); with `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=__KEY__` also shipped (`log_shipped:"sdk"`, failed exports re-emitted
  with `"sdk_failed"`). Handle: `logger()`, `client()`, `shipped()`, `flush()`, `close()`, `canary(msg, attrs)`.
- `with_request_id(id, future)`, `current_request_id()`.
